title: Power Apps: form fill assistance suggests updates to fields that already have values
summary: The briefing passes: its roadmap facts, licensing and documented controls are supported, and it distinguishes the planned existing-value suggestions from today's documented behaviour. The environment control path reaches the correct setting but should include the remaining step to edit it.

claims.claim: The planned change is a Power Apps capability.
claims.quote: "products": ["Power Apps"]

claims.where: title; summary; What's changing; Why it matters; rationales: risk and impact
claims.claim: Microsoft plans to extend form fill assistance in model-driven apps to suggest updates to fields that already contain values rather than just empty fields.
claims.quote: We’re expanding form fill assistance in model-driven applications in Power Apps to suggest updates to fields that already contain values—not just empty fields.
